notes: Developer-authored contract for country-code domains, fixed before implementing the candidate; provisional project reading policy, pending independent linguistic review. No synthesized audio. The external English sample carries Vecernji.hr and Amazon.co.uk, which no rule recognised, so the dot reached the synthesizer. Adding every ISO 3166 code was measured on that sample with no regression, but a probe showed the failure mode it cannot see: 'See fig.no 3' becomes a domain because a lowercase two-letter English word follows a period. Codes that are also common English words are therefore left out, and the list says which.
